reproduction: A diagnostic attempted to start the Guest pi.cmd through cmd.exe /d /c with a dynamically composed quoted command line and waited for its exit code.
observation: The PowerShell Direct call did not return within 30 seconds; a Host wrapper with the exact pi-list-test command remained alive. This probe did not establish a reliable exit-code method.
expected: A bounded benign package-list check should complete and leave a durable result without an interactive Pi process.
impact: The diagnostic method itself became another control-plane wait and could leave a Guest child; it must not be reused for installer verification.
evidence: Host pwsh command line containing pi-list-test and the timed-out tool call.
optimization_location: method/pi-flare-workbench/guest-native-install-pi.ps1; use a Guest-created wrapper script with an exit marker and bounded child cleanup.
minimal_change: Stop the exact probe wrapper, inspect the already-installed package directly, and remove dynamic cmd.exe quoting from the main installer.
rollback: No Guest sample state changed; discard only the diagnostic temp logs/process.
verification: Package.json/version and pi list read through a short direct Guest command; installer terminal status independent of process ExitCode.
unresolved_risk: A future installer still needs bounded child cleanup; its marker must be written by the Guest wrapper itself, not inferred from Start-Process.
